journey.name: contact pay font scale recreation
journey.description: Paying from Contact Detail survives an activity recreation. A font-scale change recreates the activity while the contact's payment details are still resolving; the pending payment must stay alive and open the send amount screen exactly once, and leaving the screen must still cancel it. Requires a funded regtest wallet, a Pubky profile and a saved contact whose Pay opens a payment, such as one that publishes public payment details. The sheet-route steps also need a saved contact that can receive payment requests (a second linked Bitkit identity); skip and report them without one. Resolution takes about a second: send the tap and the font-scale command in one `adb shell` invocation, and slow the network on an emulator when the amount screen opens before the change lands. A run where the amount screen was already open when the font scale changed proves nothing; repeat it. Android only: iOS has no activity recreation. No payment is sent.

actions.action: Run `adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0`, open the saved contact from Contacts and verify Pay (testTag "ContactPay") is visible
Direct route, for a contact that shows no Request or Pay sheet: tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay") and, with the same `adb shell` invocation, run `settings put system font_scale 1.3`
Verify the send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") opens once with the contact's name, at the larger font scale, and no "Unable To Pay Contact" toast appears in a screenshot

Close the payment flow without paying and verify Contact Detail shows Pay (testTag "ContactPay") without a spinner and no Request or Pay sheet (testTag "RequestOrPaySheet"), and no second amount screen opens within 5 seconds
Tap Pay again without changing the font scale and verify the send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") opens; close it without paying

Sheet route, for a contact that can receive payment requests: tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay"), verify the Request or Pay sheet (testTag "RequestOrPaySheet") opens, then tap Pay on the sheet and, with the same `adb shell` invocation, run `settings put system font_scale 1.0`

Verify the Request or Pay sheet (testTag "RequestOrPaySheet") is shown again on the recreated screen with its Pay button loading, then the send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") opens once; close it without paying

Leaving on the direct route: tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay") and, with the same `adb shell` invocation, run `settings put system font_scale 1.3`; wait until the recreated Contact Detail shows Pay (testTag "ContactPay") loading, then press Back with `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK`, which leaves Contact Detail for the contact list

Verify no send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") opens within 10 seconds and no toast appears; if the amount screen opened before Back was pressed, close it and record the step as not proven

Dismissing on the sheet route: tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay"), tap Pay on the Request or Pay sheet and, with the same `adb shell` invocation, run `settings put system font_scale 1.0`; wait until the recreated sheet shows Pay loading, then press Back, which dismisses the sheet and stays on Contact Detail
Verify the sheet closes, Pay (testTag "ContactPay") is not loading and no send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") opens within 10 seconds
Run `adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0`
